QUOTE: SSE reader / stdio stderr reader | `transport_sse.cpp:107`, `transport_stdio.cpp:164` | Reads transport streams
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer lists an SSE reader and a stdio stderr reader as spawn sites. It never says each MCP transport runs its own thread, and it describes the stdio thread vaguely as "reads transport streams" rather than as a stderr forwarder. It also says it did not read those loop bodies.
